item.title: NSU Makers’ Faire set for Dec. 9-12
item.description: Northwestern State University’s annual Makers’ Faire will be Tuesday, Dec. 9-Friday, Dec. 12 in Orville Hanchey Gallery. The Makers’ Faire will feature original art, paintings, pottery, sculpture and crafts created by students, faculty and alumni of NSU’s Fine and Graphic Arts Department. item.title: School Board discusses sales tax check delays, calendar planning
item.description: The Natchitoches Parish School Board met Dec. 2 for its monthly committee meeting, where members received updates on sales tax collections, performance pay, district calendars, and transportation.
